report_ready.selected_article: Inoue, H., Watari, S., Sawada, H., Lavergne, E. and Yamashita, Y. (2023). Impacts of regime shift on the fishery ecosystem in the coastal area of Kyoto prefecture, Sea of Japan, assessed using the Ecopath model. Fisheries Science 89:573–593. DOI: 10.1007/s12562-023-01691-9.
report_ready.other_known_articles: No additional independent model study is recorded in the reviewed LME 050 paper inventory. The 2024 correction concerns Open Choice and copyright and supplies no scientific parameter correction. This is not an exhaustive literature search.
report_ready.selected_model: 50_502013_Coastal_Kyoto_Inoue_(2013): Coastal Kyoto 2013, warm regime; coastal waters off Kyoto from the coast to 240 m depth, reported area 2,230 km². Forty source ecological groups: 38 consumers, Phytoplankton (39) and Detritus (40). The loaded synthetic diet-import group (41) is computational, not an additional source ecological group.
report_ready.other_models: 50_501985_Coastal_Kyoto_Inoue_(1985): the same 40-group coastal Kyoto domain in the cold regime, retained as a useful comparison. Sardine biomass and catches were much higher in 1985; 2013 represents the warmer regime with a changed fishery structure. Both reconstructions retain the unresolved year-specific diet issue.
report_ready.selection_rationale_model: User selected 2013 because it is newer and retained 1985 as a good comparison. Recency is the reason; no numerical-superiority conclusion was recorded.
report_ready.model_extraction: All 240 retained Table 1 source cells agree with the canonical 2013 model, including five preserved blanks. One published Table 2 diet matrix is captioned for both years, although the text describes sardine/anchovy dominance changing between years. Nine nonunit diet totals, accepted runtime normalization, GS 0.2, derived biomass accumulation, missing/default catch and migration, and single-detritus routing remain documented. Supplementary depth-bin areas sum to 1,223 km², versus 2,230 km² in the main paper; the discrepancy remains unresolved.
report_ready.geographic_fit: A (LME covered by study) approximately 0.15–0.23%; B (study covered by LME) approximately 95–100%. Low-confidence indicative ranges.
report_ready.temporal_fit: The model represents 2013; the report reference is 2019 landings, six years later, within the regional 1950–2019 catch series. Benthic source sampling spans 2013–2014. Applying fixed 2013 coefficients and local catch/biomass allocation proxies across the whole series assumes that their trophic and composition relationships transfer across years, including the 1988/1989 regime shift documented by the source.
report_ready.geography_limitation_for_caption_or_othe: The approximate native Figure 1 trace covers 1,681 km², 24.6% below the main paper's 2,230 km²; supplementary depth bins separately total 1,223 km². These are distinct graphical and source quantities. The indicative overlap ranges are not statistical confidence intervals, and geography supplies no catch/PPR scaling multiplier.
report_ready.ee_floor_context: The requested EE floor is a runtime assumption handled by the diagnostic review. It does not correct published inputs, resolve the source diet/area discrepancies or establish researcher approval.
